crosswalks.label: Software Developers
crosswalks.rationale: Software Developers directly ground software maintenance, debugging and modification while the AXM package narrows the work to existing-system continuity.

crosswalks.label: Computer Programmers
crosswalks.rationale: Computer Programmers ground code modification/debugging and tool use but do not define the broader compatibility/migration profession.

findings.summary: Software maintenance is not generic feature development: defect repair, dependency updates and refactoring must preserve accepted contracts or explicitly hand semantic change to owners.
findings.rationale: Research-first compilation makes the profession boundary explicit before use.

gaps_against_body.description: Make local repair success, backward compatibility, dependency migration and product-semantic authority separate evidence surfaces.

nonclaims: No complete Software Maintainer reconstruction is claimed.
Occupational mappings are evidence, not profession identity.
No TEST/WORKING/CANON or adjacent authority is created.

high_stakes.authorization_nonclaim: No adjacent professional, user, legal, platform or institutional authority is created.
